discovery_method: ML model-task taxonomy sweep — grounded in the HuggingFace task taxonomy (huggingface.co/tasks) and a notable canonical model/library per task, plus spaCy/NLTK NLP ops and scikit-learn classic-ML ops (WebSearch+WebFetch).
governance: CANDIDATES ONLY — discovery is not trust. No row here is an active capability; each is one ML model TASK (with a canonical model/library named as its source) and must pass the seeder's gap/lift screen, then human/eval gates, before any promotion. Source URLs are as reported; license/verify_note flags carried verbatim. serves_truth=false for everything downstream — model output (especially generative) is a CANDIDATE artifact that must be verified, never truth. determinism_ceiling: classic/discriminative ML inference ~0.85, generative ~0.4. Generic chat/LLM-completion deliberately excluded; routes to the inference plane, not the task registry.

candidates.intent: Assign one or more predefined categories (sentiment, topic, intent, toxicity) to an input text using a fine-tuned encoder model.
candidates.input_contract: a text string plus a fixed, pre-trained label set
candidates.output_contract: predicted label(s) with confidence scores over the fixed taxonomy
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model gives free-text opinions, not a calibrated label over a FIXED taxonomy with a probability per class for routing/gating.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a trained discriminative classifier returning deterministic label+score over a known schema, enabling thresholded routing and audit.
candidates.verify_note: transformers Apache-2.0; pipeline tag confirmed on HF tasks page. Per-checkpoint license/label-set varies — pin the model and its taxonomy.

candidates.intent: Label each token in a sequence with a tag (named entity, part-of-speech, chunk) — e.g. extract PERSON/ORG/LOC/MISC spans.
candidates.input_contract: a text string and a fixed tag scheme (e.g. IOB NER labels)
candidates.output_contract: per-token tags / entity spans with offsets and confidence
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model asked for entities returns prose lists without reliable character offsets or a fixed entity schema, breaking downstream linking.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a sequence tagger emitting spans with exact offsets over a known label set, feeding entity linking/dedupe deterministically.
candidates.verify_note: dslim/bert-base-NER tags LOC/ORG/PER/MISC (confirmed in search). transformers Apache-2.0; checkpoint license varies.

candidates.intent: Condense a long document into a shorter abstractive (or extractive) summary.
candidates.input_contract: a source text (within model max length) plus length/ratio controls
candidates.output_contract: a shorter summary string
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Summaries are generative and can fabricate or drop load-bearing facts — output must be treated as a candidate, never truth.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a dedicated summarizer with length control and a stable interface; pairs with a verification/groundedness gate before use.
candidates.verify_note: Generative task: serves_truth=false, requires faithfulness check. transformers Apache-2.0; bart-large-cnn weights MIT per its card (confirm).

candidates.intent: Translate text from a source language to a target language with a specialized NMT model.
candidates.input_contract: a source-language text plus a source/target language pair
candidates.output_contract: the translated target-language text
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A general model translates inconsistently for low-resource pairs and lacks a fixed, auditable per-pair model with known training data (OPUS).
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds pair-specific NMT models trained on OPUS with a stable interface; quality is bounded and benchmarkable per language pair.
candidates.verify_note: MarianMT models trained on OPUS data (confirmed). transformers Apache-2.0; per-pair model cards mostly CC-BY-4.0 — confirm. Generative: verify for high-stakes use.

candidates.intent: Translate between 200+ languages (incl. many low-resource) with a single multilingual model.
candidates.input_contract: source text plus source/target language codes (FLORES-200 codes)
candidates.output_contract: translated target-language text
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Most translation tooling collapses on low-resource languages; a bare model has no reliable coverage for the long tail of 200 languages.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds single-model coverage across 200 languages so the long tail is reachable with one stable interface.
candidates.verify_note: NLLB-200 supports 200+ languages (confirmed). Distilled-600M license is CC-BY-NC-4.0 — NON-COMMERCIAL; review before any commercial promotion. Generative.

candidates.intent: Answer a question by extracting the exact answer span from a provided context passage.
candidates.input_contract: a question plus a context passage
candidates.output_contract: an answer span (with start/end offsets) and a confidence score
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Generative QA hallucinates; extractive QA is constrained to spans that actually exist in the source, giving citable, grounded answers.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds span-extractive QA that returns offsets into the source (citable) plus an abstain/no-answer signal, reducing fabrication.
candidates.verify_note: Extractive (answer must be in context) — more verifiable than generative QA. transformers Apache-2.0; checkpoint license varies (SQuAD2 supports no-answer).

candidates.intent: Classify text into ARBITRARY, caller-supplied candidate labels with no task-specific training, via NLI entailment.
candidates.input_contract: a text plus a list of candidate label strings (and optional hypothesis template)
candidates.output_contract: each candidate label with an entailment probability
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Standard classifiers need a fixed label set + training; here the label set is unknown at build time and changes per request.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds NLI-based zero-shot classification so new label sets are scored immediately without retraining, with per-label probabilities.
candidates.verify_note: bart-large-mnli is the canonical zero-shot classifier via NLI entailment (confirmed). MIT per model card. Calibration varies by label phrasing.

candidates.intent: Predict the most likely token(s) to fill a [MASK] position in a sentence using a masked language model.
candidates.input_contract: a text containing a mask token
candidates.output_contract: ranked candidate tokens with probabilities for the masked slot
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A chat model doesn't expose raw per-token MLM probabilities needed for cloze scoring, lexical substitution, or probing.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds direct access to MLM token distributions for slot-filling, knowledge probing, and lexical-substitution candidates.
candidates.verify_note: BERT used for fill-mask / masked language modeling (confirmed). transformers Apache-2.0; bert/roberta weights Apache-2.0/MIT respectively.

candidates.intent: Produce contextual token/sequence embedding vectors from a transformer's hidden states for downstream ML.
candidates.input_contract: a text string
candidates.output_contract: a tensor of hidden-state vectors (per-token and/or pooled)
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare chat interface returns text, not the raw numerical hidden-state features needed to train classifiers or build indexes.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic vectorization of inputs (frozen-model features) feeding clustering, classification, and retrieval.
candidates.verify_note: Deterministic given fixed weights/precision. transformers Apache-2.0. Distinct from sentence-similarity (this returns hidden states, not tuned sentence embeddings).

candidates.intent: Compute semantic similarity between texts via tuned sentence embeddings and cosine similarity (semantic search, clustering, dedupe).
candidates.input_contract: one or more text strings (a query and a corpus, or pairs)
candidates.output_contract: dense sentence embeddings and/or pairwise similarity scores
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model cannot produce comparable fixed-dim embeddings for fast vector search/clustering over a corpus.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds MTEB-grade sentence embeddings (15k+ models) for deterministic semantic retrieval, clustering, and near-dup detection.
candidates.verify_note: sentence-transformers Apache-2.0, 15k+ models, MTEB-linked (confirmed). Embedding dim varies by model — pin it (cf. repo DEFAULT_SCHEMA_DIMENSIONS).

candidates.intent: Generate state-of-the-art multilingual text embeddings for retrieval, classification, clustering, and bitext mining.
candidates.input_contract: a text (or query+document) plus an optional instruction prefix
candidates.output_contract: a dense embedding vector
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Older embedders underperform cross-lingually and on long context; a bare model exposes no tuned embedding head at all.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a top-MTEB multilingual embedder (0.6B/4B/8B sizes) for high-recall retrieval and clustering across languages.
candidates.verify_note: Qwen3-Embedding series (0.6B/4B/8B) confirmed in search; Apache-2.0 typical for Qwen3 — confirm on card. Pin embedding dim.

candidates.intent: Re-score and reorder a candidate list of passages by relevance to a query using a cross-encoder (query+passage scored jointly).
candidates.input_contract: a query plus a list of candidate passages (e.g. top-k from a retriever)
candidates.output_contract: a relevance score per passage and the reordered list
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Bi-encoder retrieval misranks; a bare model can't jointly attend over query+passage to produce calibrated relevance scores at scale.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a cross-encoder reranker that sharpens top-k ordering (retrieve-then-rerank), measurably improving precision@k.
candidates.verify_note: Retrieve-then-rerank pattern + bge-reranker confirmed in search. sentence-transformers Apache-2.0; reranker checkpoint license varies.

candidates.intent: Rerank documents for a query with an instruction-aware reranker for retrieval/RAG pipelines.
candidates.input_contract: a query, candidate documents, and an optional task instruction
candidates.output_contract: per-document relevance scores and reordered results
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Relevance ranking without a dedicated scorer is unstable across queries and ignores task instructions.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds an instruction-conditioned reranker (0.6B/4B/8B) so retrieval ordering adapts to the task, improving RAG grounding.
candidates.verify_note: Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B confirmed in search (sibling to Qwen3-Embedding). License typically Apache-2.0 — confirm on card.

candidates.intent: Transcribe speech audio to text (multilingual), with punctuation, casing, and timestamps; optionally translate speech to English.
candidates.input_contract: an audio file/stream plus optional language and timestamp flags
candidates.output_contract: a transcript string (optionally with word/segment timestamps)
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A text model cannot read audio; speech has no extractable text without an ASR model.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds robust multilingual transcription (100+ languages, noise-robust, cased+punctuated) as a stable upstream step.
candidates.verify_note: whisper-large-v3 trained on 1M hrs labeled + 4M pseudo-labeled, 100+ languages (confirmed). Apache-2.0. Output varies with audio quality; verify transcripts for high-stakes use.

candidates.intent: Transcribe speech to text via a self-supervised acoustic model (often fine-tuned per language) with CTC decoding.
candidates.input_contract: a 16kHz audio waveform plus optional language model for decoding
candidates.output_contract: a transcript string
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Some deployments need on-device/low-latency CTC ASR or per-language fine-tunes that a general model can't provide.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a lightweight, fine-tunable acoustic ASR alternative to Whisper for constrained/streaming or low-resource settings.
candidates.verify_note: Wav2Vec2/MMS named alongside Whisper as popular ASR (confirmed). wav2vec2-base-960h Apache-2.0. Needs 16kHz input; benefits from an LM.

candidates.intent: Synthesize natural-sounding speech audio from input text, optionally conditioned on a speaker embedding.
candidates.input_contract: a text string plus an optional speaker/voice embedding
candidates.output_contract: a generated speech audio waveform
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A text model produces text, not audio; rendering speech requires a TTS model + vocoder.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds controllable text-to-speech (speaker-conditioned) as a stable downstream rendering step for voice outputs.
candidates.verify_note: SpeechT5 named for TTS on HF (confirmed). speecht5_tts MIT; needs a vocoder (e.g. hifigan) + speaker embeddings. Generative audio.

candidates.intent: Assign labels to audio clips (sound events, music genre, keyword spotting, language ID, emotion).
candidates.input_contract: an audio clip plus a fixed label set
candidates.output_contract: predicted audio label(s) with confidence
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A text/chat model can't analyze raw audio spectra to detect sound events or classify clips.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds spectrogram-based audio classification (e.g. AudioSet event tags) as a deterministic upstream signal.
candidates.verify_note: AST is a canonical audio classifier (AudioSet). License BSD-3-Clause per card (confirm). Label set fixed to the fine-tune (AudioSet 527 classes).

candidates.intent: Transform audio into modified audio — e.g. separate sources (vocals/accompaniment), denoise, or do speech enhancement.
candidates.input_contract: a mixed/noisy audio waveform plus a task selection
candidates.output_contract: one or more cleaned/separated audio waveforms
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model can't perform DSP-grade source separation or denoising on raw waveforms.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds trained separation/enhancement models (e.g. SepFormer) producing isolated stems or denoised audio for downstream ASR.
candidates.verify_note: Asteroid is a recognized audio-to-audio toolkit (MIT). SpeechBrain SepFormer checkpoints on HF carry their own (often Apache-2.0) terms — pin per model.

candidates.intent: Assign a categorical label to an image from a fixed class set (e.g. ImageNet-1k).
candidates.input_contract: an image plus a fixed label set
candidates.output_contract: predicted class label(s) with confidence
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A text model can't classify pixels; image labeling needs a trained vision model.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds ViT image classification over a known taxonomy with calibrated scores for routing/triage.
candidates.verify_note: ViT is a canonical image classifier (confirmed). vit-base-patch16-224 Apache-2.0. Class set fixed to the fine-tune (ImageNet-1k).

candidates.intent: Classify images into ARBITRARY, caller-supplied text labels with no training, via image-text contrastive similarity.
candidates.input_contract: an image plus a list of candidate text labels
candidates.output_contract: each label with a similarity/probability score for the image
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Standard image classifiers need a fixed trained label set; here labels are arbitrary and supplied at request time.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds CLIP zero-shot image classification so new visual categories are scored instantly without retraining.
candidates.verify_note: CLIP is the canonical zero-shot image classifier (confirmed). clip-vit-base-patch32 MIT. Scores depend on label phrasing.

candidates.intent: Locate and classify multiple objects in an image, returning bounding boxes with class labels.
candidates.input_contract: an image plus an optional confidence threshold
candidates.output_contract: a list of boxes (coords), class labels, and confidence scores
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A text model can't localize objects or emit precise bounding-box coordinates from an image.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds transformer object detection (boxes+labels+scores) that simplifies the Faster/Mask-R-CNN stack and extends to panoptic.
candidates.verify_note: DETR = first transformer detector, extensible to panoptic (confirmed); RT-DETR is the real-time variant. detr-resnet-50 Apache-2.0. COCO classes by default.

candidates.intent: Detect objects described by ARBITRARY text queries (open-vocabulary) without category-specific training.
candidates.input_contract: an image plus free-text object queries
candidates.output_contract: boxes + matched query labels + confidence for detected objects
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Closed-set detectors miss novel categories; a bare model can't localize text-described objects with boxes.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds open-vocabulary detection so new object types (named in text) are localized without retraining.
candidates.verify_note: OWL-ViT is the canonical open-vocab detector. owlvit-base-patch32 Apache-2.0. Recall on rare queries is bounded.

candidates.intent: Partition an image into regions/masks — semantic, instance, or panoptic segmentation.
candidates.input_contract: an image plus a segmentation mode/label set
candidates.output_contract: per-pixel masks with class/instance labels
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A text model can't produce per-pixel masks delineating objects/regions in an image.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds unified semantic/instance/panoptic segmentation (one architecture) producing precise masks for measurement/editing.
candidates.verify_note: Mask2Former is a canonical unified segmenter. Weights carry a non-standard (other/CC-BY-NC) license on some cards — review before commercial use.

candidates.intent: Generate segmentation masks for any object given point/box prompts (promptable, class-agnostic 'segment anything').
candidates.input_contract: an image plus prompts (points, boxes, or 'everything' mode)
candidates.output_contract: high-quality object masks with quality scores
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model can't produce promptable, class-agnostic masks for arbitrary objects from a click or box.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds promptable segmentation (and, in SAM 3, concept-prompted detect+segment+track) for interactive masking at scale.
candidates.verify_note: SAM-ViT-huge Apache-2.0. SAM 3 / SAM 3.1 (Meta, 2026) add concept prompts + tracking with their own checkpoints/terms — confirm SAM3 license separately.

candidates.intent: Predict a per-pixel depth map from a single RGB image (monocular depth estimation).
candidates.input_contract: a single RGB image
candidates.output_contract: a per-pixel depth/disparity map
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model can't infer 3D scene depth from a flat image; depth requires a trained geometry model.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds robust monocular depth maps for 3D reasoning, background blur, or robotics from a single frame.
candidates.verify_note: Depth Anything V2 is a canonical monocular-depth model. Large variant is CC-BY-NC-4.0 (non-commercial); Small is Apache-2.0 — pick by license need.

candidates.intent: Detect anatomical/structural keypoints (e.g. human pose joints, facial landmarks) in an image.
candidates.input_contract: an image (optionally with detected person boxes)
candidates.output_contract: keypoint coordinates with confidence per landmark
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A text model can't localize body joints or facial landmarks with pixel coordinates.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds pose/landmark keypoints as deterministic geometric features for activity, ergonomics, or AR pipelines.
candidates.verify_note: keypoint-detection is an official HF CV task; ViTPose is a widely-used pose model. License Apache-2.0 per card (confirm; some ViTPose weights are non-commercial).

candidates.intent: Assign an action/event label to a video clip (action recognition).
candidates.input_contract: a short video clip (sampled frames) plus a fixed label set
candidates.output_contract: predicted action label(s) with confidence
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model can't reason over temporal frame sequences to recognize actions in video.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds spatiotemporal video classification (e.g. Kinetics actions) for indexing/moderation of video.
candidates.verify_note: VideoMAE is a canonical action-recognition model. Kinetics fine-tune commonly CC-BY-NC-4.0 — review for commercial use. Frame sampling affects results.

candidates.intent: Produce dense/global image embedding vectors (self-supervised) for visual retrieval, clustering, and downstream heads.
candidates.input_contract: an image
candidates.output_contract: an image embedding vector (and/or patch features)
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A chat model returns text, not the visual feature vectors needed to index/cluster images or train lightweight heads.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds strong frozen visual features (DINOv2) for deterministic image search, near-dup detection, and few-shot heads.
candidates.verify_note: image-feature-extraction is an official HF CV task; DINOv2 is a leading self-supervised backbone. dinov2-base Apache-2.0 (some DINOv2 sizes are non-commercial).

candidates.intent: Generate a natural-language caption/description for an image.
candidates.input_contract: an image (optionally a prompt prefix)
candidates.output_contract: a descriptive caption string
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Captioning is generative and can describe things not present (hallucinate); output is a candidate, not ground truth.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds image captioning as an upstream signal (alt-text, indexing) — bounded and benchmarkable, gated before downstream trust.
candidates.verify_note: BLIP named for image-to-text/captioning (confirmed). blip-image-captioning-large BSD-3-Clause. Generative: serves_truth=false.

candidates.intent: Answer questions over a document IMAGE using both text and 2D layout (forms, invoices, receipts).
candidates.input_contract: a document image plus a question (OCR words+boxes may be derived internally)
candidates.output_contract: an extracted answer span grounded in the document, with location
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A text model loses 2D layout; a generative VLM may fabricate field values — layout-aware extraction grounds the answer in the page.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds layout-aware document QA returning grounded answer spans with positions, reducing fabricated form values.
candidates.verify_note: LayoutLM jointly learns text+layout; impira fine-tune on DocVQA+SQuAD2 (confirmed). License MIT per card (confirm). Needs OCR upstream.

candidates.intent: Answer natural-language questions over a structured table (cell selection and aggregation) without writing SQL.
candidates.input_contract: a table (rows/columns) plus a natural-language question
candidates.output_contract: selected cells and/or an aggregated answer (sum/count/avg)
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model reading a table as flat text mis-aligns rows/columns and miscomputes aggregates; TAPAS grounds answers in actual cells.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds table-grounded QA (cell selection + aggregation ops) so answers trace to specific cells, improving auditability.
candidates.verify_note: TAPAS is the canonical table-QA model (confirmed). tapas-base-finetuned-wtq Apache-2.0. Bounded to table size; complex multi-hop is weak.

candidates.intent: Answer a natural-language question about the content of an image.
candidates.input_contract: an image plus a question
candidates.output_contract: an answer (label or short text) with confidence
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A text model can't see the image; a bare VLM answer is generative and may hallucinate visual details.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a compact VQA model (classification-style answers) as a bounded visual-reasoning signal to be verified before trust.
candidates.verify_note: ViLT (vilt-b32) is a canonical VQA model (confirmed). vilt-b32-finetuned-vqa Apache-2.0. Answers from a fixed VQA vocabulary; verify for high-stakes.

candidates.intent: Recognize text from a cropped text-line image via a transformer OCR model (printed or handwritten).
candidates.input_contract: a cropped text-line image
candidates.output_contract: the recognized text string for that line
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A text model can't read pixels; recognizing text from image crops needs an OCR model (handwriting especially).
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds transformer OCR for line-level recognition (incl. handwritten variants) feeding deterministic text extraction.
candidates.verify_note: TrOCR named for image-to-text/OCR (confirmed). trocr-base-printed MIT (printed) / -handwritten variant exists. Needs line detection upstream; output verified for high-stakes.

candidates.intent: Generate an image from a text prompt (and optional negative prompt / size / seed).
candidates.input_contract: a text prompt plus generation params (steps, guidance, seed)
candidates.output_contract: a generated image
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A text model can't render pixels; image synthesis needs a diffusion model. Output is fully generative — a candidate, never evidence.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds controllable text-to-image generation (seedable for reproducibility) behind the diffusers interface.
candidates.verify_note: diffusers library Apache-2.0; SDXL weights under CreativeML OpenRAIL-M (use restrictions) — review. Generative: serves_truth=false; provenance/watermarking advised.

candidates.intent: Transform an input image into a modified image conditioned on structure (edges/pose/depth) plus a text prompt.
candidates.input_contract: a source/condition image plus a text prompt and control type
candidates.output_contract: a generated, structure-conditioned image
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model can't perform conditioned image editing/translation respecting an input's structure.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds structure-controlled image-to-image (ControlNet) for guided edits, inpainting, and style transfer.
candidates.verify_note: diffusers Apache-2.0; ControlNet weights commonly OpenRAIL/Apache — pin per checkpoint. Generative; verify and watermark.

candidates.intent: Process an image together with a text prompt to produce text (open-ended visual reasoning / instruction following).
candidates.input_contract: one or more images plus a text instruction
candidates.output_contract: a generated text response
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Open-ended VLM output is generative and can hallucinate; it is a candidate visual reading, not verified fact.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds general image+text reasoning as a bounded agent/signal behind a port, gated before any downstream trust.
candidates.verify_note: image-text-to-text is an official HF multimodal task. transformers Apache-2.0; per-VLM weights vary (LLaVA = LLaMA-derived terms). serves_truth=false.

candidates.intent: Predict a categorical label for a structured/tabular data row using a classic ML classifier.
candidates.input_contract: a feature row (numeric/categorical) against a trained model
candidates.output_contract: a predicted class plus class probabilities
candidates.gap_hypothesis: LLMs are weak, uncalibrated, and slow at tabular prediction; a trained classifier is accurate, fast, and reproducible on features.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a deterministic, fit/predict tabular classifier with calibrated probabilities and feature importances for structured data.
candidates.verify_note: scikit-learn BSD-3-Clause; RandomForest/HistGB confirmed in search (v1.9, v1.10 in dev). Deterministic given fixed seed/data.

candidates.intent: Predict a continuous numeric value for a tabular row using a classic ML regressor.
candidates.input_contract: a feature row against a trained regressor
candidates.output_contract: a predicted numeric value (optionally with intervals)
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A general model can't reliably regress numeric targets from features; classic regressors are precise and auditable.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic numeric prediction with feature importances and reproducible fit/predict over tabular data.
candidates.verify_note: scikit-learn includes SVM/RF/gradient-boosting regressors (confirmed). BSD-3-Clause. Deterministic given fixed seed.

candidates.intent: Partition unlabeled feature vectors into clusters (KMeans / DBSCAN / HDBSCAN / hierarchical).
candidates.input_contract: a matrix of feature vectors plus a clustering config (k or density params)
candidates.output_contract: a cluster assignment per row (and centroids/medoids where applicable)
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model can't compute reproducible cluster assignments over vectors; clustering needs a deterministic algorithm.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds reproducible unsupervised grouping (e.g. for dedupe clusters / dimension discovery) over embeddings or features.
candidates.verify_note: scikit-learn includes k-Means/DBSCAN/HDBSCAN/hierarchical (confirmed). BSD-3-Clause. KMeans deterministic given fixed seed/init.

candidates.intent: Flag anomalous/outlier rows in tabular or feature data without labels.
candidates.input_contract: a matrix of feature vectors plus a contamination/threshold setting
candidates.output_contract: an anomaly score and inlier/outlier flag per row
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model can't compute reproducible outlier scores over a dataset; anomaly detection needs a fitted detector.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic outlier scoring (Isolation Forest / LOF) for data-quality gates and review-ticket triggers.
candidates.verify_note: scikit-learn provides IsolationForest/LOF (standard). BSD-3-Clause. Threshold choice affects flags; deterministic given seed.

candidates.intent: Reduce high-dimensional feature/embedding vectors to a low-dimensional representation for visualization or compression.
candidates.input_contract: a matrix of high-dim vectors plus target dimensionality
candidates.output_contract: a low-dimensional embedding matrix
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model can't compute a stable linear/nonlinear projection of vectors; this needs a fitted reducer.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds reproducible dimensionality reduction (PCA/SVD) for embedding visualization, denoising, and index compression.
candidates.verify_note: scikit-learn PCA/TruncatedSVD are standard, deterministic (PCA exact). BSD-3-Clause. UMAP/t-SNE are separate libs and stochastic.

candidates.intent: Forecast future values of a time series (zero-shot) from historical observations using a pretrained foundation model.
candidates.input_contract: a historical numeric series (optionally covariates) plus a forecast horizon
candidates.output_contract: point and probabilistic (quantile) forecasts over the horizon
candidates.gap_hypothesis: General LLMs underperform tuned numerical models on forecasting; a bare model has no calibrated horizon/quantile output.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds zero-shot probabilistic forecasting (univariate/multivariate/covariate, per Chronos-2) as a strong baseline without training.
candidates.verify_note: Chronos-2 (Oct 2025) supports univariate/multivariate/covariate zero-shot; deployable on AWS as of Jun 2026 (confirmed). Apache-2.0. Sampling introduces variance — seed it.

candidates.intent: Zero-shot forecast future values of a time series with Google's TimesFM foundation model.
candidates.input_contract: a historical numeric series (optionally covariates) plus a horizon and frequency
candidates.output_contract: point (and quantile) forecasts over the horizon
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Forecasting needs a model trained on series dynamics; a general chat model produces unreliable numeric horizons.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a production-tested zero-shot forecaster (TimesFM 2.5, univariate+covariate) as a baseline alternative to Chronos.
candidates.verify_note: TimesFM 2.5 available Feb 2026 for univariate+covariate; battle-tested at Google (confirmed). Apache-2.0 typical — confirm on card.

candidates.intent: Forecast time series with classic statistical models (AutoARIMA, ETS, Theta) at scale.
candidates.input_contract: one or many historical series plus a horizon and seasonality
candidates.output_contract: point and prediction-interval forecasts per series
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Classic statistical forecasting (ARIMA/ETS) is exact and interpretable; a model can't fit these or emit calibrated intervals.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds fast, deterministic statistical forecasters (AutoARIMA/ETS/Theta) — a transparent, reproducible baseline for many series.
candidates.verify_note: statsforecast (Nixtla) is a leading classical-forecasting lib (confirmed). Apache-2.0. Deterministic, interpretable; pairs with foundation models for comparison.

candidates.intent: Unified forecasting and anomaly detection across classical and deep models with one fit/predict API.
candidates.input_contract: a TimeSeries object plus a chosen model and horizon
candidates.output_contract: forecasts (and anomaly scores) with a consistent interface
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Comparing many forecasting models requires a unified harness a model can't provide; ad-hoc forecasts aren't reproducible.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds one interface over ARIMA→deep nets (+ anomaly detection) so models are swapped/benchmarked deterministically.
candidates.verify_note: Darts unifies classics→deep nets with fit()/predict() (confirmed). Apache-2.0. Deep models are stochastic; classical components deterministic.

candidates.intent: Run a production NLP pipeline: tokenization, POS tagging, dependency parsing, lemmatization, sentence segmentation, and NER in one pass.
candidates.input_contract: a text document plus a loaded language model (e.g. en_core_web_sm/trf)
candidates.output_contract: a typed Doc with tokens, POS, dependencies, lemmas, sentences, and entity spans
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A chat model gives unstructured prose, not a deterministic linguistic annotation graph (offsets, dep arcs, lemmas) for downstream code.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a fast, production-grade structured-NLP pipeline emitting offsets/arcs/lemmas/entities for deterministic processing.
candidates.verify_note: spaCy MIT; provides tokenization/POS/dep-parse/lemmatization out of the box (confirmed). Statistical components vary by model; rule-based pieces deterministic.

candidates.intent: Reduce words to their base/dictionary form (lemma) using rule-based + lookup lemmatization.
candidates.input_contract: tokens (with POS context) from a spaCy Doc
candidates.output_contract: a lemma per token
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Lemmatization needs morphological rules/lookups; asking a model per word is slow, costly, and inconsistent.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic, fast lemmatization (rule+lookup) for normalization, indexing, and dedupe keys.
candidates.verify_note: spaCy lemmatizer (rule/lookup/edit-tree) confirmed in docs. MIT. Largely deterministic; trainable edit-tree variant depends on the model.

candidates.intent: Produce the syntactic dependency tree of a sentence (head/child arcs with relation labels).
candidates.input_contract: a sentence/text plus a loaded spaCy model
candidates.output_contract: dependency arcs (head, dependent, relation) per token
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model can describe grammar in prose but won't emit a machine-readable dependency tree with consistent arc labels.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds structured syntactic parsing for relation extraction, clause splitting, and grammar-aware features.
candidates.verify_note: Dependency parsing is core spaCy (confirmed). MIT. Statistical parser — output bounded by the loaded model; deterministic at inference.

candidates.intent: Match tokens/phrases against deterministic patterns or gazetteers to tag entities/spans by RULE (no model).
candidates.input_contract: a text plus token/phrase patterns or a gazetteer
candidates.output_contract: matched spans with the assigned label
candidates.gap_hypothesis: For known terminologies a model is overkill and non-deterministic; rule/gazetteer matching is exact and auditable.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds fully deterministic pattern/gazetteer entity tagging — ideal for controlled vocabularies and compliance terms.
candidates.verify_note: Matcher/PhraseMatcher/EntityRuler are rule-based spaCy components (confirmed). MIT. Fully deterministic given the patterns.

candidates.intent: Classic NLP preprocessing: word/sentence tokenization, stopword removal, and Porter/Snowball stemming.
candidates.input_contract: a text string plus language/stemmer options
candidates.output_contract: tokens / sentences / stems with stopwords removed
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Reproducible classic tokenization/stemming is rule-based; an LLM is non-deterministic and slow for bulk preprocessing.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic, dependency-light text preprocessing (tokenize/stem/stopword) for feature pipelines and baselines.
candidates.verify_note: NLTK is the canonical classic-NLP toolkit (confirmed). Apache-2.0. Deterministic; better for teaching/baselines than production speed (cf. spaCy).

candidates.intent: Look up lexical-semantic relations (synonyms, hypernyms/hyponyms, definitions) from the WordNet database.
candidates.input_contract: a word/lemma (and optional POS)
candidates.output_contract: synsets with definitions, synonyms, and hypernym/hyponym links
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model can paraphrase a thesaurus but can't return WordNet's curated, citable synset graph with stable IDs.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic access to a curated lexical knowledge base (synsets/relations) for query expansion and ontology grounding.
candidates.verify_note: NLTK exposes WordNet (Princeton WordNet license — permissive). NLTK code Apache-2.0. Deterministic lookups; English-centric.

candidates.intent: Detect the language of a text quickly across 100+ languages.
candidates.input_contract: a text string
candidates.output_contract: predicted language code(s) with confidence
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Language routing needs a fast, deterministic detector; invoking an LLM per snippet is slow and overkill.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a tiny, fast 176-language identifier as a deterministic routing/preprocessing step ahead of NLP models.
candidates.verify_note: fastText MIT; lid.176 is the canonical language-ID model (CC-BY-SA-3.0 for that model file — confirm). Deterministic; weak on very short text.

candidates.intent: Reconstruct a 3D representation (mesh/point cloud/NeRF/Gaussian) from one or more 2D images.
candidates.input_contract: one or more images of an object/scene
candidates.output_contract: a 3D model/asset (mesh or point cloud)
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model can't infer 3D geometry from 2D images; reconstruction needs a trained 3D model.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds image-to-3D asset generation as a bounded, generative step (output is a candidate asset to validate).
candidates.verify_note: image-to-3D is an official HF CV task. Tooling Apache-2.0; per-model weights (e.g. TripoSR) vary, often non-commercial — review. Generative.

candidates.intent: Generate novel images with NO conditioning input (sample from a learned image distribution).
candidates.input_contract: a generation request plus optional seed/count
candidates.output_contract: generated image samples
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A text model can't sample images from a distribution; unconditional synthesis needs a generative image model.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds unconditional sampling (e.g. for data augmentation / distribution study) behind the diffusers interface.
candidates.verify_note: unconditional-image-generation is an official HF CV task. diffusers Apache-2.0; per-model weights vary. Generative; seed for reproducibility.

candidates.intent: Generate a short video clip from a text prompt.
candidates.input_contract: a text prompt plus duration/resolution/seed params
candidates.output_contract: a generated video clip
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A text model can't synthesize moving frames; video generation needs a dedicated diffusion/transformer video model.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds text-to-video generation as a bounded generative step (output is a candidate asset, never evidence).
candidates.verify_note: text-to-video is an official HF CV task. diffusers Apache-2.0; per-model weights (Wan/CogVideoX) carry their own (often non-commercial) terms — review. Generative.

candidates.intent: Retrieve relevant document PAGES by embedding page images directly (vision-based retrieval, no OCR), matched to a text query.
candidates.input_contract: a text query plus a corpus of document page images
candidates.output_contract: ranked page images with relevance scores
candidates.gap_hypothesis: OCR-then-embed pipelines lose visual layout/figures; a bare model can't embed page images for late-interaction retrieval.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds vision-native document retrieval (late-interaction over page-image patches) capturing layout/figures OCR drops.
candidates.verify_note: visual-document-retrieval is an official HF multimodal task; ColPali is the canonical model. Built on a Gemma/PaliGemma base — weights carry Gemma terms (NON-standard); review before commercial use.

candidates.intent: Process audio together with a text instruction to produce text (audio reasoning/QA, transcription+understanding).
candidates.input_contract: an audio input plus a text instruction
candidates.output_contract: a generated text response about the audio
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A text model can't hear; combined audio+text reasoning output is generative and must be verified, not trusted.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds audio-grounded text generation (e.g. audio QA, event description) as a bounded signal behind a port.
candidates.verify_note: audio-text-to-text is an official HF multimodal task. transformers Apache-2.0; per-model weights (Qwen2-Audio) vary. serves_truth=false.

candidates.intent: Process a video together with a text prompt to produce text (video QA/captioning/temporal reasoning).
candidates.input_contract: a video (sampled frames) plus a text instruction
candidates.output_contract: a generated text response about the video
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A text model can't watch video; combined video+text output is generative and may hallucinate temporal/visual facts.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds video-grounded text generation (QA/summary) as a bounded, verifiable signal for video indexing/moderation.
candidates.verify_note: video-text-to-text is an official HF multimodal task. transformers Apache-2.0; per-model weights vary. serves_truth=false; frame sampling affects output.

candidates.intent: Train/apply a text categorizer head on top of spaCy for document/intent classification within the pipeline.
candidates.input_contract: a text plus a trained textcat component with a fixed label set
candidates.output_contract: label scores over the configured categories
candidates.gap_hypothesis: For a fixed in-house taxonomy, a small trained textcat is cheaper, faster, and more stable than an LLM call.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds an in-pipeline trainable classifier with per-label scores, integrated with spaCy's deterministic tokenization.
candidates.verify_note: TextCategorizer is a core spaCy component (confirmed). MIT. Output bounded by the trained model; deterministic at inference.

candidates.intent: Extract the most representative keywords/keyphrases from a document using embedding similarity to the doc.
candidates.input_contract: a document text plus n-gram range and top-n
candidates.output_contract: ranked keyphrases with relevance scores
candidates.gap_hypothesis: An LLM 'list keywords' is non-deterministic and unranked; KeyBERT grounds keyphrases in embedding similarity to the source.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds reproducible, scored keyphrase extraction (candidate n-grams ranked by similarity) for tagging/indexing.
candidates.verify_note: KeyBERT MIT; uses sentence-transformers embeddings under the hood. Deterministic given a fixed embedder; quality bounded by candidate generation.

candidates.intent: Discover topics in a document collection via embeddings + clustering + class-based TF-IDF, with interpretable topic words.
candidates.input_contract: a collection of documents plus clustering/embedding config
candidates.output_contract: topic assignments per doc plus top words per topic
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model can't perform reproducible corpus-level topic discovery with cluster assignments and ranked topic terms.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds modular topic modeling (embed→reduce→cluster→c-TF-IDF) producing inspectable topics for corpus organization.
candidates.verify_note: BERTopic MIT; modular over embeddings/UMAP/HDBSCAN. UMAP/HDBSCAN add stochasticity — seed for stability. Optional LLM topic-labeling is generative.

candidates.intent: Detect and redact/anonymize PII (names, emails, SSNs, cards, phones) in text using recognizers + NER + checksums.
candidates.input_contract: a text plus the PII entity types to detect and an anonymization policy
candidates.output_contract: detected PII spans with types/scores and an anonymized output
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Compliance-grade PII handling needs validated, auditable detectors (regex+checksum+NER), not an LLM's best guess.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a configurable PII detection+anonymization engine combining deterministic recognizers with NER for redaction gates.
candidates.verify_note: Presidio MIT; combines regex/checksum (deterministic) with NER (model-based) — recall varies. Aligns with repo redaction/safety rules; never store real PII.

candidates.intent: Score text for toxicity/severe-toxicity/obscene/threat/insult/identity-attack with a trained classifier.
candidates.input_contract: a text string
candidates.output_contract: per-category toxicity probabilities
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Moderation gates need calibrated, fixed-schema toxicity scores; a chat model's free-text judgment isn't thresholdable or auditable.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds multi-label toxicity scoring (Jigsaw-trained) as a deterministic moderation/triage signal over a fixed schema.
candidates.verify_note: Detoxify Apache-2.0 (models trained on Jigsaw data; note dataset license/bias caveats on the card). Deterministic scores; calibrate thresholds per use.

candidates.intent: Transcribe speech with a CTranslate2-optimized Whisper for faster, lower-memory inference (incl. word timestamps).
candidates.input_contract: an audio file plus language/beam/timestamp options
candidates.output_contract: a transcript with segment/word timestamps
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Vanilla Whisper is heavy for batch/CPU; a bare model can't run optimized speech inference at scale.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a 4x-faster, lower-memory Whisper runtime (CTranslate2) for cost-efficient batch transcription on CPU/GPU.
candidates.verify_note: faster-whisper MIT; reimplements Whisper on CTranslate2. Output ~matches Whisper (still generative). Pairs with the repo's CPU-batch inference lane.

candidates.intent: Determine 'who spoke when' in an audio recording (speaker segmentation + clustering).
candidates.input_contract: an audio file plus optional number-of-speakers hint
candidates.output_contract: speaker-labeled time segments (start, end, speaker id)
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A text model can't segment audio by speaker; diarization needs trained speaker-embedding + clustering models.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds speaker diarization to turn raw audio into per-speaker segments, enriching transcripts for meetings/calls.
candidates.verify_note: pyannote diarization pipeline (3.1) is canonical; code MIT but gated HF access + accept-conditions required. Clustering introduces variance.

candidates.intent: Identify language across 1600+ languages/scripts (wide-coverage language ID for the long tail).
candidates.input_contract: a text string
candidates.output_contract: predicted language/script label with confidence
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Mainstream detectors cover ~few-hundred languages; the long tail (1600+) is unreachable for a bare model.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds extreme-coverage language ID (1600+) for routing low-resource-language content correctly before NLP.
candidates.verify_note: GlotLID is a fastText-based wide-coverage LID model; Apache-2.0 (model file license — confirm). Deterministic; short-text accuracy lower.

candidates.intent: Transcribe speech with NVIDIA NeMo Parakeet/Canary ASR (high-accuracy, multilingual, with speech translation).
candidates.input_contract: an audio file plus language options
candidates.output_contract: a transcript (optionally translated, with timestamps)
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Some deployments need top-of-leaderboard accuracy or streaming ASR that a general model can't provide.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds NeMo's state-of-the-art ASR/speech-translation models as an alternative high-accuracy transcription backend.
candidates.verify_note: NVIDIA's updated multilingual ASR + speech translation (Dec 2025) referenced in search. NeMo framework Apache-2.0; specific checkpoints (Canary/Parakeet) often CC-BY-4.0 — confirm per model.

candidates.intent: Detect objects in images/video in real time with a transformer detector that needs no NMS post-processing.
candidates.input_contract: an image/frame plus a confidence threshold
candidates.output_contract: boxes + labels + scores at real-time latency
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Real-time, NMS-free detection is a specialized capability a general model has no path to.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds low-latency end-to-end detection (no NMS) suitable for streaming/video pipelines, complementing DETR.
candidates.verify_note: RT-DETR has an official HF model_doc (confirmed). rtdetr_r50vd Apache-2.0. COCO classes by default; distinct from offline DETR by latency profile.

candidates.intent: Detect tables in document images and recognize their row/column/cell structure (table extraction from images).
candidates.input_contract: a document page image
candidates.output_contract: table bounding boxes plus a row/column/cell structure grid
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A text model can't recover a table's grid from a page image; structure recognition needs a vision model.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds image-based table detection + structure recognition feeding deterministic cell extraction (vs text-PDF-only parsers).
candidates.verify_note: Table Transformer (TATR) is the canonical image table-structure model; MIT. Output varies with image quality; pairs with OCR for cell text.

candidates.intent: Assign a semantic class label to every pixel of an image (semantic segmentation) with an efficient transformer.
candidates.input_contract: an image plus a fixed class set (e.g. ADE20K/Cityscapes)
candidates.output_contract: a per-pixel class map
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A text model can't produce dense per-pixel semantic labels from an image.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds efficient semantic segmentation over a known class set for scene parsing, masking, and measurement.
candidates.verify_note: SegFormer is a canonical semantic segmenter; NVIDIA weights carry a non-standard research license (other) — review before commercial use. Class set fixed to the fine-tune.

candidates.intent: Correct grammatical errors in a sentence (grammatical error correction) via a text-to-text model.
candidates.input_contract: a text with potential grammatical errors
candidates.output_contract: the corrected text
candidates.gap_hypothesis: GEC output is generative and can over-edit or change meaning; corrections are candidates needing diff review, not silent truth.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a dedicated, small GEC model with a stable interface for editing pipelines, cheaper/more focused than a general LLM.
candidates.verify_note: vennify/t5-base-grammar-correction trained on grammar correction (confirmed in search); Apache-2.0 typical for these T5 fine-tunes — confirm. Generative: diff and verify edits.

candidates.intent: Generate paraphrases (semantically equivalent rewrites) of an input sentence.
candidates.input_contract: a sentence plus number-of-variants
candidates.output_contract: one or more paraphrased sentences
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Paraphrasing is generative and can drift from the source meaning; outputs are candidates requiring equivalence checks.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds focused paraphrase generation (data augmentation, query variants) with a stable small-model interface.
candidates.verify_note: Vamsi/T5_Paraphrase_Paws is a widely-used paraphrase model (confirmed in search); model-card license unverified. Generative: verify semantic equivalence.

candidates.intent: Restore casing and punctuation to unpunctuated text (e.g. raw ASR transcripts).
candidates.input_contract: lowercased/unpunctuated text
candidates.output_contract: text with restored casing and punctuation
candidates.gap_hypothesis: ASR output often lacks punctuation/casing; a bare model rewriting it can hallucinate content rather than just repunctuate.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a token-level punctuation/casing restorer (constrained edits) to make transcripts readable and segmentable.
candidates.verify_note: fullstop punctuation-restoration model is a common ASR post-processor; MIT per card (confirm). Token-tagging style is more constrained than free generation.

candidates.intent: Upscale and restore images/video (4x super-resolution) while removing real-world artifacts.
candidates.input_contract: a low-resolution image (and a scale factor)
candidates.output_contract: a higher-resolution, artifact-reduced image
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A text model can't synthesize high-frequency detail to upscale images; super-resolution needs a trained generator.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds practical 4x image/video super-resolution + artifact removal as a bounded generative enhancement step.
candidates.verify_note: Real-ESRGAN = synthetic-trained 4x upscaler/artifact remover (confirmed); BSD-3-Clause per repo (confirm). Generative detail — not faithful reconstruction; verify for evidentiary use.

candidates.intent: Restore degraded/old/AI-generated faces (blind face restoration) using GAN priors.
candidates.input_contract: an image containing faces
candidates.output_contract: an image with restored facial detail
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model can't reconstruct facial detail from a degraded image; blind face restoration needs StyleGAN2-prior models.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds practical face restoration (pairs with Real-ESRGAN for background) as a bounded generative enhancement.
candidates.verify_note: GFPGAN uses StyleGAN2 priors for blind face restoration (confirmed); license Apache-2.0 per repo (confirm). Generative: invents plausible detail — never use as identity evidence.

candidates.intent: Segment and remove the background of an image, returning the foreground subject with an alpha matte.
candidates.input_contract: an image
candidates.output_contract: the foreground subject with transparency (alpha mask)
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A text model can't produce an alpha matte separating subject from background.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds high-quality background removal/matting as a deterministic-ish preprocessing step for compositing/product images.
candidates.verify_note: RMBG-2.0 is a leading background-removal model but carries a non-commercial/creative-use Bria license (other) — review; rembg (MIT wrapper) bundles a permissive U2Net alternative.

candidates.intent: Classify the emotion (angry/happy/sad/neutral, etc.) expressed in a speech audio clip.
candidates.input_contract: a speech audio clip plus a fixed emotion label set
candidates.output_contract: predicted emotion label(s) with confidence
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A text model can't read vocal prosody; speech-emotion recognition needs an acoustic classifier.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds prosody-based emotion classification over a fixed label set as a signal for call analytics/UX.
candidates.verify_note: SpeechBrain wav2vec2 SER on IEMOCAP is a common SER model (confirmed); Apache-2.0 per SpeechBrain (confirm). Labels fixed to the training set; accuracy modest and culturally biased — treat as a soft signal.

candidates.intent: Resolve which mentions in a text refer to the same entity (coreference clusters).
candidates.input_contract: a text document
candidates.output_contract: clusters of coreferring mention spans (with offsets)
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Linking pronouns/mentions to entities with exact offsets is structured; a chat model gives prose, not span clusters for downstream linking.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds coreference clustering with offsets so entity-linking/dedupe can merge mentions across a document deterministically.
candidates.verify_note: coreferee (spaCy pipeline) MIT; HF neuralcoref is the older spaCy coref project (now legacy). Statistical — output bounded by the model; deterministic at inference.

candidates.intent: Classify the logical relation (entailment / contradiction / neutral) between a premise and a hypothesis.
candidates.input_contract: a premise text and a hypothesis text
candidates.output_contract: a relation label (entailment/neutral/contradiction) with probabilities
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A chat 'is this entailed?' answer isn't a calibrated 3-way label; NLI gives thresholdable scores for fact-consistency gates.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds calibrated entailment scoring — a building block for groundedness/faithfulness checks and zero-shot routing.
candidates.verify_note: DeBERTa-v3 MNLI is a standard NLI scorer; DeBERTa-v3 MIT (specific MNLI fine-tune license varies). Useful as a verification primitive — itself a candidate signal, not final truth.

candidates.intent: Find visually/semantically similar images to a query image or text via shared image-text embeddings.
candidates.input_contract: a query image or text plus an indexed image corpus
candidates.output_contract: ranked similar images with similarity scores
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A bare model can't embed images and text into one space for cross-modal retrieval over a corpus.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds CLIP joint image-text embeddings for deterministic visual search and text-to-image retrieval/dedupe.
candidates.verify_note: CLIP image-text embeddings are the canonical cross-modal retrieval primitive; clip-vit-large-patch14 MIT. Deterministic given fixed weights; pin embedding dim.

candidates.intent: Classify audio into ARBITRARY, caller-supplied text labels with no training, via audio-text contrastive embeddings.
candidates.input_contract: an audio clip plus a list of candidate text labels
candidates.output_contract: each label with a similarity/probability for the audio
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Fixed audio classifiers can't score arbitrary new labels; a bare model can't relate audio to text at all.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds CLAP zero-shot audio classification + audio-text retrieval so new sound categories are scored without retraining.
candidates.verify_note: CLAP is the canonical zero-shot audio classifier / audio-text embedder; clap-htsat-unfused Apache-2.0 (confirm). Scores depend on label phrasing.

candidates.intent: Train/serve high-accuracy gradient-boosted trees for tabular classification or regression.
candidates.input_contract: a feature matrix plus a trained booster and task type
candidates.output_contract: predictions (class probabilities or numeric values) with feature importances
candidates.gap_hypothesis: LLMs lose to gradient-boosted trees on most tabular tasks; a bare model offers no calibrated, fast tabular predictor.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds best-in-class tabular GBDT (often SOTA on structured data) with reproducible training and SHAP-able importances.
candidates.verify_note: XGBoost Apache-2.0; the de-facto tabular GBDT (alongside LightGBM/CatBoost). Deterministic given fixed seed/threads; complements scikit-learn HistGB.

candidates.intent: Detect, segment, classify, and track objects/poses in images and video in real time (YOLO family).
candidates.input_contract: an image/video frame plus a task mode (detect/segment/pose/track) and a model
candidates.output_contract: boxes/masks/keypoints + labels + scores (and track ids for video)
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Real-time multi-task vision (detect+segment+pose+track) at the edge is far outside a general model's reach.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a fast, unified vision stack (detect/segment/pose/track) for streaming pipelines with one interface.
candidates.verify_note: Ultralytics YOLO is AGPL-3.0 (commercial license available) — copyleft review required before bundling into a closed product. COCO classes by default.

candidates.intent: Detect and recognize text within natural-scene images across 80+ scripts (scene text recognition).
candidates.input_contract: a natural-scene image plus a language list
candidates.output_contract: recognized text regions with bounding boxes and confidence
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A text model can't read text baked into photos/signage; scene-text recognition needs a detection+recognition OCR.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds ready-to-use multi-script scene-text OCR (Latin/CJK/Arabic/Cyrillic/Devanagari) with box+confidence output.
candidates.verify_note: EasyOCR Apache-2.0 (confirmed earlier); deep-learning OCR — output varies with image quality. Listed as a distinct TASK (scene text) vs document-OCR engines.

candidates.intent: Split a document into sentences (sentence boundary detection) deterministically within the NLP pipeline.
candidates.input_contract: a text document plus a loaded spaCy model or sentencizer
candidates.output_contract: a list of sentence spans with offsets
candidates.gap_hypothesis: Reliable sentence splitting (abbreviations, decimals, quotes) is rule/statistical; an LLM per doc is slow and non-deterministic.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds fast sentence segmentation with offsets — a deterministic chunking primitive for retrieval and per-sentence scoring.
candidates.verify_note: spaCy Sentencizer is rule-based (deterministic); parser-based boundaries are statistical. MIT. A core preprocessing primitive.
